brief.zh: 泻湖上的共和国，世界的秤。塞浦路斯的棉与法兰西的呢绒在里亚尔托易手，东方的丝金到此价可翻数倍。契约须有证人与蜡印——无印则如无风之帆。
brief.en: A republic on a lagoon, and the scales of the world. Cypriot cotton and Frankish wool change hands at the Rialto; eastern silk-and-gold multiplies here. A contract needs witnesses and wax — without a seal it is a sail without wind.

brief.zh: 十字军在东方最后一座大港，城墙里挤着比萨人、热那亚人、威尼斯人各自的区，彼此讲不同的话，收不同的税。往东的一切都从这里起算。
brief.en: The last great crusader haven in the East: Pisan, Genoese and Venetian quarters packed inside one wall, each with its own speech and its own customs house. Everything eastward is measured from here.

brief.zh: 两海之间的城，金角湾的锁链一放，黑海的粮与皮毛便进来。拉丁人刚被赶走，热那亚人却在对岸的加拉塔安顿了下来。
brief.en: The city between two seas. Drop the chain across the Golden Horn and the grain and furs of the Black Sea come in. The Latins have just been driven out; the Genoese have settled comfortably across the water at Galata.

brief.zh: 绿洲之城，倭马亚大寺的院子里终日有人在读书、睡觉、争论。朝觐的大队每年从这里出发去麦加——错过它，你就得自己穿过沙漠。
brief.en: A city in an oasis. In the courtyard of the great mosque men read, sleep and argue all day. The hajj caravan leaves here for Mecca once a year — miss it and you cross the desert alone.

brief.zh: 尼罗河养着的大城，人多得像是全世界都搬来了。爱资哈尔的学圈里坐着从马格里布到呼罗珊的学生；卡里米商人的钱能在印度洋两岸兑现。
brief.en: The great city the Nile feeds, so crowded it seems the world moved in. In the circles at al-Azhar sit students from the Maghrib to Khurasan; a Karimi merchant's paper is good on both shores of the Indian Ocean.

brief.zh: 谷中的城。朝觐月里，从马格里布、印度、中亚、东非来的人在同一个院子里绕行，说着彼此听不懂的话做同一件事。非穆斯林不得入内。
brief.en: A city in a valley. In the pilgrimage month, people from the Maghrib, India, Central Asia and East Africa circle the same court, doing one thing in a dozen tongues. Non-Muslims may not enter.

brief.zh: 海峡这一侧的小城，望得见对岸的山。所有向东走的人都从这里开始数日子；所有回来的人都在这里被问：你见到了什么。
brief.en: A small town on this side of the strait, within sight of the far mountains. Everyone going east starts counting days here; everyone coming back is asked the same question: what did you see.

brief.zh: 伊儿汗的都城，四方商路的结。热那亚人、威尼斯人、亚美尼亚人、汉人使者同在一个巴扎里做生意；城外的马拉盖有一座天文台，星表还在续写。
brief.en: The Ilkhan's capital and the knot of four trade roads. Genoese, Venetians, Armenians and envoys from Cathay do business in one bazaar; at Maragha outside the city an observatory is still adding to its tables.

brief.zh: 海湾口上的港，热得人夏天躲进水里坐着。印度的马、香料、珍珠在此换手；船板用椰索缝合，不用铁钉——波罗说他不敢乘。
brief.en: A port at the mouth of the Gulf, so hot that in summer men sit in the water. Indian horses, spice and pearls change hands here; the ships are sewn with coir and carry no iron nail — Polo says he would not sail in one.

brief.zh: 河中之地最大的城，果园环城，纸出于此而胜于他处。景教徒与穆斯林共用一条街，为一根柱子争了三代人。
brief.en: The greatest city of Transoxiana, ringed with orchards, where the paper is better than anywhere else. Nestorians and Muslims share one street and have argued over a single column for three generations.

brief.zh: 马拉巴尔的胡椒港。扎莫林的秤是全海最公道的一杆——货上岸，秤定价，谁也不许赖。季风把整个海的船按时表送来送走。
brief.en: The pepper port of Malabar. The Zamorin's scales are the fairest on the ocean — goods ashore, weight fixed, no one welches. The monsoon delivers and removes the whole sea's shipping on a timetable.

brief.zh: 海峡最窄处的港。每一阵季风都必须在此换手：东来的等西风，西来的等东风，于是两边的人都得住下来，学对方的话。
brief.en: A port at the narrowest of the strait. Every monsoon must change hands here: those from the east wait for the west wind, those from the west for the east — so both sides stay ashore and learn each other's speech.

brief.zh: 刺桐港。番坊自成一街，波斯语、阿拉伯语与闽南话在同一个屋檐下讨价还价；清真寺的宣礼声与天妃宫的锣声隔街相闻，谁也不觉得奇怪。
brief.en: The port of Zayton. The foreign quarter is a street unto itself, where Persian, Arabic and the local tongue haggle under one roof; the call from the mosque and the gong from the sea-goddess's temple cross the street at each other, and nobody finds it strange.

brief.zh: 大汗的冬都，方城十二门，夜里击钟之后无人得在街上行走。宫里同时养着景教士、萨满、番僧与占星家——他们各说各的，大汗都听。
brief.en: The Khan's winter capital: a square city with twelve gates, and after the night bell no one may walk the streets. The palace keeps Nestorian priests, shamans, lamas and astrologers all at once — each says his own thing, and the Khan listens to all of them.
